data.content:
Didi
The technology company that provides the Honghu Backend platform and supports the bus group's customer service operations.
data.file_path: 网约公交客服管理·商户培训手册V20250905.pdf

data.content:
Order Closure
A feature to close orders, either free or paid, for resolving issues.
data.file_path: 网约公交客服管理·商户培训手册V20250905.pdf

data.content:
Bus Group
The public transportation company responsible for customer service issues, who uses the Honghu Backend.
data.file_path: 网约公交客服管理·商户培训手册V20250905.pdf

data.content:
Passenger
The user of the online bus service who may contact customer service with issues.<SEP>Passenger is the customer who books rides and may experience problems like duplicate charges, being charged without taking a ride, lost items, or driver service issues.
data.file_path: 网约公交客服管理·商户培训手册V20250905.pdf

data.entity_name: Online Bus Customer Service Management and Merchant Training Manual V20250811
data.content:
Online Bus Customer Service Management and Merchant Training Manual V20250811
A manual providing instructions on using the Honghu backend for customer service management and merchant training.
data.file_path: 网约公交客服管理·商户培训手册V20250905.pdf

data.content:
Refund
A feature allowing refunds for online and offline orders, supporting full or partial refunds.<SEP>Refund is the operation to return payment to a passenger for an order, applicable to both online and offline orders, with details displayed after processing.
data.file_path: 网约公交客服管理·商户培训手册V20250905.pdf

data.content:
Virtual Number
A feature that generates a temporary virtual phone number to allow customer service to contact passengers without revealing real numbers.
data.file_path: 网约公交客服管理·商户培训手册V20250905.pdf

data.content:
Honghu Backend
A software management platform used by bus groups for handling customer service issues including generating virtual numbers, processing refunds, and order closures.
data.file_path: 网约公交客服管理·商户培训手册V20250905.pdf

data.content:
Online Order
Orders placed through the Didi mini-program or app, with payment after trip completion.<SEP>Online order refers to a ride order placed and paid through the online platform, supported for cancellation and refund operations by merchant administrators.
data.file_path: 网约公交客服管理·商户培训手册V20250905.pdf

data.content:
Order Cancellation
Order cancellation is the operation to close an order, available for unpaid online orders, and can be free or paid depending on the scenario.
data.file_path: 网约公交客服管理·商户培训手册V20250905.pdf

data.content:
宏鹄管理后台
宏鹄管理后台is a management backend system used by merchant administrators to handle online and offline ride orders, including operations like refund and order cancellation.
data.file_path: 网约公交客服管理·商户培训手册V20250905.pdf

data.content:
Free Order Cancellation
Free order cancellation closes an online order without requiring the passenger to pay, used when the order is unpaid and issues like duplicate charge or non-ride are confirmed.
data.file_path: 网约公交客服管理·商户培训手册V20250905.pdf

data.content:
Customer Service
The staff of the bus group responsible for handling passenger complaints and using the Honghu Backend features.<SEP>Customer Service is the team that handles passenger inquiries and complaints, using standard scripts to comfort passengers, record issues, and provide guidance on invoice application and navigation problems.
data.file_path: 网约公交客服管理·商户培训手册V20250905.pdf

data.content:
Paid Order Cancellation
Paid order cancellation closes an order but still requires the passenger to pay, applied when the passenger has alighted but the driver has not ended the trip.
data.file_path: 网约公交客服管理·商户培训手册V20250905.pdf

data.content:
Offline Order
Orders where the passenger scans a code to board and pays directly.<SEP>Offline order refers to a ride order conducted offline, possibly involving cash payment, and can be refunded in case of duplicate charges.
data.file_path: 网约公交客服管理·商户培训手册V20250905.pdf

data.content:
Merchant Administrator
Merchant administrator is a role that operates refund and order cancellation in the宏鹄管理后台, handling issues like duplicate charges and incorrect ride charges.
data.file_path: 网约公交客服管理·商户培训手册V20250905.pdf

data.content:
Duplicate Charge
Duplicate charge is a situation where a passenger is charged twice for the same ride, detectable by matching online and offline orders by date, time, and driver.
data.file_path: 网约公交客服管理·商户培训手册V20250905.pdf

data.content:
Charge Without Ride
Charge without ride occurs when a passenger is charged despite not having taken the ride, possibly due to driver error or failure to cancel correctly, resolved by refund or free cancellation.
data.file_path: 网约公交客服管理·商户培训手册V20250905.pdf

data.content:
Early Drop-off Fare Issue
Early drop-off fare issue arises when a passenger wants to alight before the destination but the fare remains unchanged due to the fixed-price model of网约公交.
data.file_path: 网约公交客服管理·商户培训手册V20250905.pdf

data.content:
Driver Service Issue
Driver service issue refers to complaints about driver behavior, requiring investigation and possible penalties, with standard scripts used to appease the passenger.
data.file_path: 网约公交客服管理·商户培训手册V20250905.pdf

data.content:
Administrator
Staff members designated by the bus company to have permissions for generating virtual numbers and managing passenger contact, especially for future restricted access.
data.file_path: 网约公交客服管理·商户培训手册V20250905.pdf

data.content:
Lost Item
Lost item is a situation where a passenger leaves belongings in a vehicle, triggering a search procedure and standard responses to reassure the passenger.<SEP>Lost Item is a passenger complaint type involving missing personal belongings, handled by recording details and arranging search.
data.file_path: 网约公交客服管理·商户培训手册V20250905.pdf

data.content:
Standard Script
Standard script is a predefined response template used by customer service to address common issues like service complaints and lost items.<SEP>Standard Script is a set of predefined comforting responses used by customer service to address passenger complaints regarding lost items, distant stops, and other issues.
data.file_path: 网约公交客服管理·商户培训手册V20250905.pdf

data.content:
网约公交
网约公交is a ride-hailing bus service with a fixed fare model, where early drop-off does not reduce the fare, and it is mentioned in the context of fare adjustment policies.<SEP>网约公交is an online-hailed bus service that recommends pickup stops based on passenger and driver locations, ensuring walking distance generally under 300 meters.
data.file_path: 网约公交客服管理·商户培训手册V20250905.pdf

data.content:
公交公司
公交公司is the bus operating company that makes final decisions on fare adjustments in cases of early drop-off, as mentioned in the standard script for handling early alightment issues.
data.file_path: 网约公交客服管理·商户培训手册V20250905.pdf

data.content:
滴滴出行
滴滴出行is a ride-hailing platform that provides the online-hailed bus service via its app or mini-program.
data.file_path: 网约公交客服管理·商户培训手册V20250905.pdf

data.entity_name: 网约公交乘客端培训手册
data.content:
网约公交乘客端培训手册
网约公交乘客端培训手册is a training manual containing a knowledge base of common passenger questions for the online-hailed bus passenger end.
data.file_path: 网约公交客服管理·商户培训手册V20250905.pdf

data.content:
电子税务局
电子税务局is the electronic tax bureau system used for issuing invoices and requiring periodic facial recognition authentication.
data.file_path: 网约公交客服管理·商户培训手册V20250905.pdf

data.content:
Stop Too Far
Stop Too Far is a passenger complaint about recommended pickup stops being too far, with a guarantee that walking distance is generally under 300 meters.
data.file_path: 网约公交客服管理·商户培训手册V20250905.pdf

data.content:
Invoice Issue
Invoice Issue is a passenger inquiry or problem regarding invoice generation or abnormal invoicing errors.
data.file_path: 网约公交客服管理·商户培训手册V20250905.pdf

data.content:
Navigation Unreasonable
Navigation Unreasonable is a passenger complaint about unreasonable navigation, which may be resolved by partial refund if strongly disputed.
data.file_path: 网约公交客服管理·商户培训手册V20250905.pdf

data.content:
Driver
Driver is the service provider who may be involved in issues such as not ending a trip, misoperation leading to charges without ride, or service complaints.
data.file_path: 网约公交客服管理·商户培训手册V20250905.pdf

data.content:
Product Issues
Product Issues are general passenger inquiries about product-related matters, addressed using the knowledge base in the training manual.
data.file_path: 网约公交客服管理·商户培训手册V20250905.pdf

data.content:
Facial Recognition Authentication
Facial Recognition Authentication is a security procedure required for login to the electronic tax bureau to resolve invoicing exceptions.
data.file_path: 网约公交客服管理·商户培训手册V20250905.pdf

data.content:
公交集团
公交集团is the bus operating company responsible for managing the online-hailed bus service and handling certain customer issues.
data.file_path: 网约公交客服管理·商户培训手册V20250905.pdf

data.content:
Partial Refund
Partial Refund is a compensation method that the bus company can apply at its discretion for navigation complaints.
data.file_path: 网约公交客服管理·商户培训手册V20250905.pdf
